Fusion Rifles are an energy-based, medium ranged special weapon category in Destiny used by Guardians. These weapons must be charged up to fire, while each charge speed varies per weapon. Fusion rifles' over-penetrating burst fire, incredible power, and advanced energy disbursement technology make them "a favorite of daring weapons collectors."

Exodus Blue is a medium-sized Crucible map located in the ruins of a long-dead colony ship of the same name. Broken pipes at the edge of the dry-dock provide a good amount of cover and vantage points for players who prefer ranged combat. Broken arms from a massive shipbuilding crane have smashed down onto train transports, providing those looking for close quarters combat a unique entrance to the interior. Exodus Blue was a PlayStation 3/4 exclusive map until the release of The Taken King.

Exotic Shard is a material in Destiny. It can be used for the final upgrade on and to ascend Year 1 exotic weapons and armor. For Year 2 gear, it is a required material for infusing exotic weapons and armor. Exotic Shards can be obtained by dismantling exotic gear. An exotic item that has the max amount of experience can be dismantled for 2 Exotic Shards. This only requires the experience to be maxed; the nodes do not need to be purchased. An exotic without the max amount of experience will only provide 1 Exotic Shard when dismantled.

Exodus Red was a Golden Age colony ship based in the Cosmodrome in Old Russia.At the time of the Collapse, the ship was packed with refugees who hoped to escape to safety. Unfortunately, as Exodus Red prepared for launch, conditions within the Cosmodrome deteriorated to the point that the ship's AI determined a successful liftoff was increasingly unlikely. The AI issued a distress signal containing its final thoughts and well-wishes for any survivors who received its message. Beyond the message, nothing is known of Exodus Red's ultimate fate. Exodus Red had an intelligent AI mind in charge of the ship that was self-aware and could feel emotions.

Fusion Rifle Telemetry is a consumable that increases the experience gained towards fusion rifles for 30 minutes. Prior to Destiny: The Taken King, they could be purchased from Xûr or from dismantling upgraded legendary fusion rifles. After The Taken King, they were replaced by Special Telemetry.

Etheric Light is a legendary material in Destiny that can be used to ascend legendary weapons to 170 Attack and legendary armor to 170 Light. It was introduced with the House of Wolves expansion. The level 34 and 35 Prison of Elders activities and the Trials of Osiris Silver Tier Package, Gold Tier Package, and chest in The Lighthouse each award one Etheric Light. Guardians may purchase one Etheric Light from Lord Saladin after reaching Iron Banner Rank 3 and another after reaching Rank 5. Etheric Light is also a random award for completing the Weekly Nightfall Strike. It can be donated to Petra Venj in exchange for Queen's Wrath reputation.

The Gravesend Mk 28 is a machine gun in Destiny. The weapon has not been described by Bungie, but has been very briefly mentioned in a Bungie news blog. No further information is available at this time.

Gunslinger is a Hunter subclass in Destiny and Destiny 2. Gunslinger's super ability is Golden Gun, a powerful illuminated hand cannon that allows for three shots, but deals tremendous damage to enemies. Golden Gun can deal precision damage in Destiny 2. This subclass also contains some area-control passive abilities that allow players to force enemies to take certain paths or doors. Gunslinger Hunters have a natural affinity to ranged combat, unlike a Bladedancer Hunter's close combat focus.

Hawkmoon is an exotic hand cannon. It was exclusive to PlayStation platforms until release of Destiny: The Taken King. The weapon's silvered barrel features intricate "hawk feather" etchings that were carved into its design.

Hadronic Essence is a Warlock-exclusive material. It is obtainable by dismantling uncommon or rarer Warlock armor. Hadronic Essence is used in upgrading rare or higher Warlock armor. After the release of The Taken King, these materials were no longer used and were replaced by Armor Materials. Guardians' existing Hadronic Essence can be traded for Armor Materials by Roni 55-30.
The Hall of Guardians is a location in the Tower where Guardians can purchase Crucible weapons and Vanguard armor.
Helm of Inmost Light is an exotic Titan helmet specifically tailored for those using the Striker subclass.

Heart of the Praxic Fire is an exotic Warlock chest armor piece. It can currently only be obtained as a random drop from Year 1 activities and legacy engrams. This armor is designed for use with the Sunsinger subclass.
Helm of Saint-14 is an exotic Titan helmet. It can be obtained from engrams or purchased from Xûr. It is best suited for the Defender subclass.
Gheleon's Demise is a legendary scout rifle. It can be purchased from Lord Saladin during the Iron Banner Crucible event.

Gravebreaker 1.3 is legendary chest armor able to be wielded by Hunters. Gravebreaker 1.3 can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Armor Materials, and Legendary Marks. It can also be transferred to other characters through the vault.

Hand Cannon Telemetry is a consumable that increases the experience gained towards hand cannons for 30 minutes. Prior to Destiny: The Taken King, they could be purchased from Xûr or from dismantling upgraded legendary hand cannons. After The Taken King, they were replaced by Primary Telemetry.
A Harvester is a Cabal troop ship. Its main role is to drop off Cabal reinforcements and equipment to the combat zone. It provides fire support from its chin-mounted incendiary rocket launcher.

Gravebreaker 2.1 is a legendary helmet able to be wielded by Hunters. Gravebreaker 2.1 can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Armor Materials, and Legendary Marks. It can also be transferred to other characters through the vault.

Gravebreaker 2.2 are legendary gauntlets able to be wielded by Hunters. Gravebreaker 2.2 can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Armor Materials, and Legendary Marks. It can also be transferred to other characters through the vault.
Graviton ESm is an uncommon shotgun. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer and Weapon Parts. It can be purchased from the Gunsmith, Banshee-44.
Hard Luck Mk. 52 is a rare hand cannon. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer and Weapon Parts.
Her Benevolence is a legendary Sniper Rifle added in the House of Wolves expansion. It can be acquired from the loot chest that is unlocked by a Treasure Key at the end of a Prison of Elders match.
Hammer of Sol is a Super Ability in the Titan Sunbreaker subclass.
